data.title: Analyzing Rigid Motions on the Coordinate Plane
data.description: Practice identifying various rigid transformations such as reflections and rotations by carefully examining pre-image and image pairs on the coordinate plane.

challenges.narration: A figure was moved on the grid.
challenges.instruction: A single transformation maps the cyan pre-image onto the amber image. Which transformation is it?
challenges.hint: Track one corner from the pre-image to the image. Did it flip across an axis (a reflection) or turn around the origin (a rotation)? Then check the exact axis or angle.
options: Reflection over the line y = x
